decisions.choice: Select 18 tracked files and 9 untracked code/test files; exclude 19 tracked collateral or provenance-unsafe files and 201 historical receipt files.
decisions.rationale: Only direct session-lifecycle behavior and bounded worktree test-harness prerequisites enter the candidate. MemoryTxnTests.cs has no demonstrated session-log dependency. PluginNativeSuiteReceiptTests.cs and PluginUpdateServiceHarnessTests.cs are excluded because they only redirect receipt lookup to PrimaryRepositoryRoot without run/source binding. PluginSessionLogCatalog.cs is a partial-hunk selection: retain SiblingPluginParent and its consumer, exclude the now-unused PrimaryRepositoryRoot helper. Historical evidence remains preserved in the original Grok worktree.
decisions.revisitTrigger: A later candidate gate proves an excluded file is a necessary dependency.

decisions.choice: Do not provision or execute provider infrastructure in P0. Record parent preflight only; retain SQLite, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL as mandatory later gates.
decisions.rationale: This delegated P0 preparation slice excludes provisioning; approved P6 validation uses supported provisioning after gates. Presence is not a passing provider test.
decisions.revisitTrigger: P6 provider validation starts or preflight identity changes.

decisions.choice: Do not run SyncAgentPlugins in P0; preserve the single approved synchronization for P5 after pre-activation gates.
decisions.rationale: Running synchronization now would mutate sibling repositories and invalidate the approved sequencing.
decisions.revisitTrigger: P5 pre-activation unit and review gates pass.

decisions.choice: Do not change timeout behavior in P0. REPL_TIMEOUT=120 is used only for this isolated audit console; the 30-second hook child budget and separate 120-second drain contract remain future implementation/validation scope.
decisions.rationale: P0 is source selection, not production or test implementation. Increasing a timeout would not remediate deadline defects.

decisions.choice: Exclude MemoryService, McpDbContext memory relationships, and all nine memory migration changes.
decisions.rationale: Inspection found memory soft-delete/relationship/Down behavior, not a demonstrated session-lifecycle dependency. Approved migration history is not reopened because of historical infrastructure failures.
decisions.revisitTrigger: A clean candidate gate produces a reproducible failure whose minimal dependency is one of these excluded changes.

decisions.choice: Preserve the public Task<string> persister contract and add the proposed internal verified-receipt adapter in P4. Use canonical-first handling: consume valid canonical YAML, fall back to whole-bundle source rediscovery only when canonical data is missing or unavailable, and retain invalid, unsupported, lossy, ambiguous, degraded, or unverified artifacts. Plugins do not ingest transcripts.
decisions.rationale: This preserves existing public callers while allowing internal persistence proof and prevents invalid canonical data from being silently normalized, discarded, or deleted. Whole-bundle fallback preserves paired metadata, messages, subagents, and provenance; plugin ingestion would duplicate the shared server pipeline.
decisions.revisitTrigger: P4 Red tests prove the public compatibility contract cannot be preserved, or a behavior/scope change requires an approved plan amendment.
